existing_signer_bridge.note: The INVERSE (EventSigner → NDKSigner) does not exist anywhere; this epic introduces it.

similar_features.ndkuser_construction_pattern: new NDKUser({ pubkey }) with no attached ndk — see nostr.ts:52,56,62,66

ndksigner_vs_eventsigner_interface_gap.implication: Adapter's sign(event) must call wrapped.signEvent(event) and return result.sig

similar_features.ndkauthpolicies_signin_location: node_modules/@nostr-dev-kit/ndk/dist/index.d.ts:670 — signIn({ ndk, signer?, debug? }); uses ndk.signer when signer arg omitted
similar_features.dynamic_relay_expansion: ndk.pool.addRelay(new NDKRelay(url, undefined, ndk), true) at client.tsx:201–202 and 240–241; the undefined is the per-relay authPolicy slot — they will inherit ndk.relayAuthDefaultPolicy if set

init_sequence: Background IIFE: first explicit network.request — client.tsx:304
architecture.auth_wiring_window: Must be in place before ndk.connect() (or before first REQ) — AUTH challenges arrive in the relay-handshake → REQ window. Cleanest: set in NDK constructor options. Alternative: post-construction setters before ndk.connect().
architecture.teardown: useEffect cleanup at client.tsx:394–413 nulls refs but does not call pool.disconnect (no clean API). Re-mount creates fresh NDK. No cross-mount AUTH state risk.
architecture.signer_prop_contract: MarmotProvider only mounts when pubkey is non-null AND signer is set (app/page.tsx:237 guards login screen, line 424 mounts provider). AC-GUARD-1 is statically guaranteed by structure but defensive guard adds protection against future regression.

testing_and_conventions.test_command: make test (= npm test = vitest run + test:export)

canonical_event_signer_stub.shape: function makeSigner(pubkey) { return { getPublicKey: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(pubkey), signEvent: vi.fn().mockImplementation(async (event) => ({ ...event, sig: 'dummy-sig', id: 'signed-event-id' })) } as unknown as EventSigner; }

mock_patterns.partial_spread: vi.mock(mod, async () => ({ ...await vi.importActual(mod), override: vi.fn() })) — used in client.test.ts

testing_and_conventions.ndk_test_mocks: NONE — no existing vi.mock for @nostr-dev-kit/ndk anywhere in src/. NDKUser is a lightweight constructor; using it directly in tests is fine without mocking.
testing_and_conventions.import_order_convention: vi.mock(...) calls BEFORE any import of the module under test (Vitest hoisting requirement; restated in forget-device.test.ts:58-59)
